source_ts_ns.meaning: Time the source says the market action occurred; Binance T or Bybit cts when present.

exchange_ts_ns.meaning: Time the exchange says it published the message; Binance E or Bybit ts.
exchange_ts_ns.fallback: receive_ts_ns only when the venue omits exchange time

receive_ts_ns.meaning: Local time at which the complete raw frame was received.

observed_ts_ns.meaning: Time at which a host-clock reference sample was observed.

derived_measurements.cross_venue_skew_ns: absolute difference between latest receive_ts_ns values for the same instrument

cross_venue_alignment: Compare latest local receive timestamps using a configured tolerance; never rewrite venue timestamps.
replay_clock: The current event receive_ts_ns is simulated now; processing speed must not affect results.
